_note: A fictional store for the local demo. Every name, price, policy and address here is made up.

store.name: Harbor & Pine
store.tagline: Clothing, home goods and small electronics, made to last.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.summary: Standard shipping is $5.95 and free on orders over $75. Express shipping is $14.95. We ship to the US and Canada.
shipping.body: Standard shipping (3 to 5 business days) costs $5.95 and is free on orders over $75. Express shipping (1 to 2 business days) costs $14.95. Orders placed before 1 pm Pacific time on a business day ship the same day. We ship to the United States and Canada.

delivery.title: Delivery times
delivery.summary: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days, express 1 to 2 business days. Orders before 1 pm Pacific time on a business day ship the same day.
delivery.body: After an order ships, standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days and express delivery 1 to 2 business days. Canada adds 2 to 4 business days. You get a tracking link by email when the order ships.

returns.title: Returns and refunds
returns.summary: You can return unused items within 30 days of delivery. Returns in the US are free with our prepaid label; refunds reach your card within 5 business days after we receive the item.
returns.body: Return unused items in their original packaging within 30 days of delivery. US returns are free with the prepaid label from our returns page; Canadian returns cost $8.95. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days of the item reaching us. Final-sale items and opened candles can't be returned.

contact.title: Contact
contact.summary: Write to help@harborandpine.example or use this chat. The team answers within one business day.
contact.body: Email help@harborandpine.example or start a chat on any page. The team answers within one business day.

hours.title: Business hours
hours.summary: The support team works Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm Pacific time.
hours.body: Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm Pacific time, closed on US public holidays. Messages sent outside these hours are answered the next business day.
